spec.name: Furniture Giant Porch Spider
spec.description: A ground-standing fantasy spider prop with a chunky purple-marked black abdomen, two raised ruby-red eyes and eight broad, stepped angular legs. Built from 28 connected, axis-aligned cuboids with individually packed UV nets; no plinth, rig or animation. Front faces negative Z.

prompt: Create an original vanilla Minecraft furniture model: large spooky black spider prop with eight broad angular jointed legs, purple markings on chunky abdomen and two prominent red eyes; ground-standing, no plinth. Grounded attractive survival-server furniture. Entire model fits x=0..32, y=0..16, z=0..32; floor y=0, front negative Z. 16 units per Minecraft block. Standing on floor y=0. Keep a 0.25-unit margin at outer x/z edges.  Use 8-30 purposeful axis-aligned cuboids, no rotations, no bones, no animation. Detailed hand-painted pixel art, coherent palette, explicit non-overlapping cube-net UVs with correct texel density. Connected physical structure, no z fighting, no stand outside the furniture. No text labels, no surrounding scene. Generate the whole piece with its distinctive silhouette and materials.
